chapter: Publishing, Jelly Roll in Los Angeles and band lore
title: Sonny Clay, drummer and bandleader
summary: Sonny Clay drummed in Johnny's band before leading his own band to Australia.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: How about Sonny Clay? We haven't talked about him much.

Well, Sonny Clay, he was a drummer, you know, and he played a little piano, too. And he had his own band after a while. He played piano in his own band. When he played with my brother... See, my brother had a...I told you he had...he had a band that...of...of musicians, and Sonny was the drummer in that band. And Sonny started his own band and that...he went all over Australia and everywhere with his band. They wanted a jazz band over there, and he took a jazz band over there, and he...
Is that the band that Ivie Anderson went to Australia with?

Mighta been. I know I don't think there's any other Negro band went over there but Sonny, and they... Sonny said they met him all out ten feet...miles out in the water...he...'cause Sonny was comin' to Australia. They was over there...oh, quite a little while, and...but he was 'round the music store all the time, and he played in my brother's band.
